messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, good morning{01 07 00}!


{07 0b 00}I didn't expect to see you
this early in the morning,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}.
{07 00 00}I wish you'd told me you
were coming by so that I
could have had some time
to {07 10 00}clean the house,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, tere hommikust{01 07 00}!


{07 0b 00}Ma ei oodanud sind näha
nii vara hommikul,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}.
{07 00 00}Soovin, et oleksid öelnud,
et tuled, et mul oleks
olnud aega
{07 10 00}maja koristada,

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh{01 07 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!

{07 14 00}I guess you must not have
any work to do today, isn't
that right, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
You always seem so busy,
{04 1f 00}. A little too

messages.et:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh{01 07 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!

{07 14 00}Sul pole vist täna tööd,

{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{04 1f 00}. Natuke liiga
hõivatud, kui minult küsida.
{07 19 00}Pea meeles, sa pead aeg-
ajalt puhkama. Oma

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Well, hello there{01 07 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, it's nice of

{07 0b 00}So, what do you think?{01 00 00 05 00}
My place looks great,

{07 19 00}I know you think I like to
{04 22 00} all the

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Noh, tere seal{01 07 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, on kena, et sa
läbi astusid!
{07 0b 00}Nii, mida sa arvad?{01 00 00 05 00}

{04 22 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Wow! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! You're
here! You're really here,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Last night,{01 00 00 05 00} I made a little
wish that you'd come visit
me today.
I wrote my wish on a piece
of paper{07 1a 00} over and over
again,{01 00 00 05 00} and now you're here!
All my hard work finally
paid off, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Vau! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Sa oled
siin! Sa oled tõesti siin,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Eile õhtul{01 00 00 05 00} soovisin ma
väikese soovi, et sa täna
mind külastaksid.
Ma kirjutasin oma soovi
paberile{07 1a 00} ikka ja jälle,{01 00 00 05 00}
ja nüüd oled sa siin!
Kogu mu raske töö tasus
lõpuks ära, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good evening{01 07 00}.
{07 0b 00}How was your day,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Nobody too mean to you?{01 00 00 05 00}
Nobody stick you with any
errands to take care of?
{07 19 00}Because if anyone ever
does, you come tell me
about it, OK, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
I'll take care of it for
you, {04 1f 00}. You can
count on that!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere õhtust{01 07 00}.
{07 0b 00}Kuidas su päev oli,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Keegi polnud sinuga õel?{01 00 00 05 00}

asjatoimetusi tegema?
{07 19 00}Sest kui keegi kunagi teeb,

sinu jaoks, {04 1f 00}. Sa
võid selle peale loota!

{07 0b 00}Why are you out so late?
